Class AntTaskHolder

java.lang.Object
org.owasp.dependencycheck.ant.logging.AntTaskHolder
public final class AntTaskHolder extends Object
Holds a reference to the current Ant Task for logging. Replaces the old StaticLoggerBinder singleton pattern used with SLF4J 1.x.

Uses ThreadLocal to ensure thread-safety when Ant runs tasks in parallel.
